name: Vercel AI SDK
description: Production-grade TypeScript SDK for building AI agents and LLM-powered applications. Provides structured tool use, streaming, structured outputs, and multi-model support. The default AI reasoning layer in web3 agent stacks where Python is not required.

ecosystem_fit.notes: Paired with AgentKit in Base AI agent workflows. The reasoning layer in the Base onchain AI agent stack.
The recommended AI reasoning layer in solana-trading-agent. Claude is the recommended LLM for complex trading reasoning per WORKFLOWS.md.
The reasoning layer in Farcaster social AI agents. Neynar webhooks → Vercel AI SDK → Neynar cast APIs.
Used in AI agent patterns on Ethereum.

common_pairings.context: Helius delivers onchain events via webhooks; Vercel AI SDK processes those events in the agent reasoning loop.
Vercel AI SDK handles LLM reasoning; Turnkey handles server-side transaction signing for the resulting decisions.
Vercel AI SDK decides what trade to make; Jupiter provides the swap routing for executing that decision.
Neynar delivers Farcaster social events; Vercel AI SDK processes them and generates cast responses for social AI agents.
Trigger.dev orchestrates agent runs with retry logic; Vercel AI SDK provides the LLM reasoning within each step.
AgentKit provides web3-native onchain actions; Vercel AI SDK provides the LLM backbone. AgentKit is built on top of Vercel AI SDK for Base agents.

trust_evidence.description: Vercel AI SDK is the default AI reasoning layer in every web3 AI agent workflow in WORKFLOWS.md. Appears in solana-trading-agent, base-onchain-ai-agent, farcaster-social-ai-agent.
Official Vercel product. v4 (ai package) is actively maintained with frequent releases and strong documentation.
Vercel AI SDK has comprehensive documentation including guides for tool use, structured outputs, and agentic patterns.

scale_guidance.hackathon: Use the `ai` package directly. Streaming hooks for React are the fastest path to a chat or agent UI.
scale_guidance.mvp: Use structured outputs for agent decision extraction — do not parse free-text LLM responses. Build tool use with proper validation.
scale_guidance.production: Use Claude (claude-opus-4-7 or claude-sonnet-4-6) for complex agent reasoning. Model LLM API costs per agent invocation. Implement max-step limits to prevent infinite loops.

alternatives.when_to_prefer: When complex multi-step reasoning chains are required, Python-native tooling is preferred, or when heavy ML/model work accompanies the agent logic.
When building specifically for Base and want web3-native onchain actions with minimal plumbing. AgentKit wraps Vercel AI SDK for Base.
When building a character-based social agent with persistent persona requirements. Less production-stable than Vercel AI SDK.

anti_patterns: Parsing free-text LLM responses to extract trading decisions — use structured outputs (`generateObject`) instead.
Not implementing max-step limits in agentic loops — unbounded agents can run expensive multi-step loops.
Using Vercel AI SDK React hooks in server-side autonomous agents — the UI hooks are browser-only. Use the Node.js `generateText` / `generateObject` functions for server-side agents.
Skipping tool validation — unvalidated tool call parameters cause runtime failures in production.
